newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: First Austrian pays at least 16 ats div.
newsitem.headline: First Austrian pays at least 16 ats div.

text.p: First Austrian, one of Austria's top five banks, will pay at least an unchanged 16 schillings dividend this year, chief executive Konrad Fuchs said on Friday.

Die Erste Oesterreichische Spar-Casse Bank AG (First Austrian) posted an operating profit of 1.37 billion schillings in the first nine months of the year, Fuchs said during an investment fair. He gave no comparative figure.
In 1995 First Austrian reported an operating profit of 1.755 billion schillings. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
